story.title: Kaya's Festival Day
sentences: It was Thursday, February fourteenth, two thousand twenty-two.
Kaya was excited to spend the night at the school festival with her grandfather.
First, they walked together into the animal area; zero other guests were there.
Many birds sang, and a cute baby elephant with a tail marking rolled bamboo.
He's usually quiet, but a boy made him run fifty feet.
"Wow, that was much fun!" Kaya said; her headache was gone.
At the third door, a man sold ninety different Spanish shorts for forty yen.
The twelfth exhibit had a blackboard; whose case showed a Hindu god.
Grandfather bought us an orange iced tea from a pet store; mine was on sale.
Kaya found a key off a bench; she didn't touch it, it doesn't belong.
The bus took them to the movie theater near Mt. Fuji's river.
This exciting day ended with dinner; she also saw a cute hamster and tennis racket.
